scope.supersedes: R20 detection study (read-only; coverage semantics now separated and a joint-bootstrap diagnostic added)

interpretation: Descriptive finite-sample behavior of the declared data-driven detection rule on one registered instance. Logical-envelope anchor containment is NOT statistical coverage and is never compared with sampling coverage. Above-limit sampling coverage is share-conditional (other channels fixed at points); its under-coverage reflects both plug-in bias and the conditional design, quantified by the joint bootstrap. The joint diagnostic does not remove plug-in bias. INDETERMINATE is an honest outcome, not a failure. Coverage rates describe this grid only, not a universal guarantee.
